title: Screening and Prevalence of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis in Selected Urban and Countryside Schools in Egypt
brief_summary: Early detection of scoliosis and determination of which areas are more affected urban or countryside will help in early management. Also, this will guide the government and the community for early intervention to decrease the factors that leads to this postural abnormality. This also will guide another clinician to search for the cause of these posture deformities and to concentrate screening for special areas with special cultures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

1. Age range from 10 to 15 years.
2. Males students.
3. Students who have structural scoliosis.

Exclusion criteria:

1. Congenital deformities.
2. Recent fracture and there is a fixation in the upper or the lower extremities
3. Neuromuscular disorder (Cerebral palsy and spinal muscle atrophy).
4. Syndromic disorders (Muscular dystrophy, Osteogenesis imperfect, and Spina-bifida).
